title: NIST SP 800-53 IA-2: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
content: Control Library Policy: Require MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) for all network access to privileged command consoles and administrative tools. Enforce conditional access controls based on source IP network blocks.

title: CIS Control 6: Access Control Management
content: Standard: Establish and maintain an inventory of all active and inactive accounts. Automatically deactivate or suspend dormant administrative user profiles after 90 days of absolute inactivity.
